_comment: klt erc supply spec for `pll_loop_filter` (T1 item 11, analog partition; issue #147).
Input: layout/sg13cmos5l-pll/reports/20261003-183059-dc5644a/pll_loop_filter.gds (top cell pll_loop_filter).
Run (repo root): klt erc <gds> <this spec> --top pll_loop_filter --format json
-- NO --deck and NO stackup[0].active_layer, unlike the four MOS blocks;
see 'Gate-less block' below and the dated ERC record's run-erc.sh.
Supplies (subckt port list `loop_filter VCTRL VSS`): VSS only. LVS pairs VSS->VSS
(pin: true). The reference's only other global, `sub!` (rppd bulk), is the
die substrate, extracted as `vsubs` and paired to SUB! -- it is not a
routed supply of this block and is not declared here.
Stackup/vias: GatPoly (5/0, gate role, NO active_layer) -> Metal1
(8/0) -> Metal2 (10/0) -> Metal3 (30/0) -> Metal4 (50/0), bridged by Cont
(6/0), Via1 (19/0), Via2 (29/0), Via3 (49/0). Same layer numbers and the
same dual-source provenance (sg13cmos5l.lyp + the curated sg13cmos5l deck
LAYER_NAMES table) as ../erc-supply-spec.json, extended by Metal4/Via3
because the MoM capacitors (Recog.mom 99/39) are drawn on Metal1..Metal4;
a declared layer the block does not draw is not an error (docs/cli/erc.md).
Label text is read from Metal1.pin (8/2) and Metal3.pin (30/2) -- the only
metal pin layers carrying text in these streams (Metal3.pin holds
cmos5l_route.py's one-per-net trunk label).
Run WITHOUT --deck (see 'Gate-less block' below), so nothing is carved out
of the gatpoly role: the one rppd body (GatPoly & PolyRes) stays in it and
conducts between its two head contacts (VCTRL<->NZ) in this model, and
provenance.deck is null and provenance.devices is empty in the report.
MoM capacitors are not carved either (MomCapacitorDevice is not matched by
--deck at this build); their two finger sets are disjoint geometry, so
they cannot merge two nets in this model. manifests/check_erc_coverage.py
requires this form: deck null, and no gate net containing a declared
supply (VSS).
Supplies: every top-level supply port of design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/<block>.spice
(DR-004 rail table), cross-checked against the same-GDS LVS net_correspondence in
layout/sg13cmos5l-pll/reports/20261003-183059-dc5644a/lvs.<block>.json. `expected_islands` is this repo's annotation (klt
erc ignores unknown keys): 1 means exactly one electrical island, which is
the only outcome without an erc.unconnected_net finding.
NO ties[] -- disclosed, not omitted. Geometry of this stream (klt layers
--flattened): no Activ (1/0), no NWell (31/0), no nSD (7/0); one pSD (14/0)
shape, which is the rppd body implant on GatPoly (with SalBlock/EXTBlock/
PolyRes), and two Cont (6/0) shapes, which are the resistor head contacts
on GatPoly. Devices: one rppd resistor and two cap_cmomi MoM capacitors --
no MOS, so no transistor body to tie. Consequently:
- n-well tie: inapplicable -- no NWell is drawn and no PMOS exists.
- substrate tie: inapplicable -- no Activ is drawn, so no p+ tap can exist;
the rppd bulk is the global substrate (reference `sub!`, extracted
`vsubs`), biased by the taps of the MOS blocks, not by this block.
Asserting a well_boxes region here would only manufacture an
erc.missing_tie finding against a block that, by design, has nothing
to tap; fabricating a tap or well to obtain a clean status is not done.
Recorded via ties_disclosure kind `unexpressible`, so klt erc reports
erc.missing_tie as inapplicable (`ties_disclosed_unexpressible`) rather than
as checked. klt signoff would grade this report `supply_spec_disclosed_
unexpressible` (unmet) if it were the cited ERC part -- it is not cited;
manifests/check_erc_coverage.py accepts this one block's disclosure only
with the geometry facts above re-verified from the GDS.
Gate-less block (klt friction, filed upstream -- see the record): klt erc
exits 1 ('no net ... has any geometry on the declared gate role') on a
layout with no transistor gate. With the four MOS blocks' form
(active_layer Activ + --deck sg13cmos5l) this stream has none: no Activ is
drawn, and --deck carves the only GatPoly (the rppd body) out of the gate
role. The committed error envelope for that form is kept in the record.
This spec therefore drops active_layer and is run without --deck, which
makes the rppd body the run's one 'gate' net and lets it conduct
VCTRL<->NZ in the connectivity model (a modelling artefact: neither is
declared, and the resistor does not touch VSS, so VSS's island count is
unaffected; the antenna figures for that 'gate' are meaningless and
unchecked anyway). Only the declared-supply verdict is used from this run.

ties_disclosure.reason: passive block (one rppd, two cap_cmomi MoM caps): no Activ, no NWell and no MOS are drawn, so neither a well tie nor a substrate tap exists to name; the rppd bulk is the global substrate biased by the MOS blocks' own taps
